verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a GitHub Actions workflow that deploys tasks on push to main. It also ships an official CLI with commands for projects, runs and environment management. A management API authenticated by secret key or personal access token supports headless, programmatic automation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, explicit documentation of non-interactive CLI authentication in CI pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: This simple GitHub action workflow will deploy your Trigger.dev tasks when new code is pushed to the `main` branch.
New CLI commands for projects, runs, and env management
There are two methods of authenticating with the management API: using a named API key associated with a specific environment in a project (`secretKey`), or using a personal access token
